shared_elements: standing human figure in profile or near-profile
elongated staff-like object held by or beside a figure
animal or bird-like figures in profile
justification: Both surfaces include schematic profile figures, some animal/bird-like forms, staff-like linear objects, and repeated sign-like motifs arranged partly in bands or registers. The strongest correspondence is the use of profile human/animal forms with surrounding signs, but A presents a relatively coherent figural scene with standing humans flanking a central action, whereas B is a stacked field of more abstract, emblematic animal and sign motifs with no matching central scene.
